test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question: The Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2015 introduced a new category of citizenship for the persons of Indian Origin of certain categories. It is officially termed as:
solution:
The Correct Answer is the __**Overseas Citizen of India Cardholder**__.

 
• **The Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2015 **introduced a new category of citizenship for the persons of Indian Origin of certain categories. It is officially termed as **Overseas Citizen of India Cardholder.**
 
• **The Indian Overseas Citizenship (OCI) **is an immigration status which requires a foreign Indian descent citizen to permanently stay and work in the Republic of India.
 
• The OCI was created by the Indian diaspora in response to demands for dual citizenship, especially in developed countries. It was introduced in** August 2005, by The Citizenship ( Amendment ) Act.**
 
• It was launched in 2005 during the **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention held in Hyderabad.**
 
• Constitution of India precludes Indian citizens from getting dual citizenship. As such, according to Indian law, the OCI is not true Indian citizenship because it has other limitations, such as no freedom to vote, no right to hold constitutional offices and no opportunity to purchase agricultural land.
 
• The **Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019** was passed by the Parliament of India on 11 December 2019.
 
 
• It amended the Citizenship Act, 1955 by providing a path to Indian citizenship for illegal migrants of Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi, and Christian religious minorities, who had fled persecution from Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan before December 2014.
